bio: A Boston local and Harvard veteran (34 years and counting!), I've been at Lowell House since 2002. I'm happy to be starting my eighteenth year at Lowell House. Whether it's housing concerns, financial questions, event planning, or you just want answers to all things Lowell, check in with me; Responses are always served with a side of opinion! Outside of work, I love traveling (especially Europe), looking at art, reading poetry, biographies, travel-writing, and essays. I'll jump in any body of water, but preferably the Caribbean or Aegean.
